findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_validation_framework, get_product_details, explain_demand_signals, get_data_source_categories, start_demand_report, validate_real_demand, get_demand_report_status · Private data: validate_real_demand · Public sink: ask_demand_discovery, get_validation_framework, get_product_details, explain_demand_signals, compare_validation_approaches, get_data_source_categories, start_demand_report, validate_real_demand, get_demand_report_status, start_agentic_launch · Destructive: get_validation_framework, explain_demand_signals, start_demand_report, validate_real_demand, get_demand_report_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_validation_framework, get_product_details, explain_demand_signals, get_data_source_categories, start_demand_report, validate_real_demand, get_demand_report_status · Private data: validate_real_demand · Public sink: ask_demand_discovery, get_validation_framework, get_product_details, explain_demand_signals, compare_validation_approaches, get_data_source_categories, start_demand_report, validate_real_demand, get_demand_report_status, start_agentic_launch · Destructive: get_validation_framework, explain_demand_signals, start_demand_report, validate_real_demand, get_demand_report_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
